blocks.prompt: 5 In how many ways 3 dishes of Desi foods and 2 dishes of Chinese foods be selected from 6 dishes of desi foods and 8 dishes of Chinese foods?
blocks.explanation:
Yahan do alag alag selections ek saath ho rahe hain: 6 desi dishes mein se 3, aur 8 Chinese dishes mein se 2.
Find kya karna hai? Poora menu kitne tareeqon se chuna ja sakta hai.
Plan: desi ke liye \({}^{6}C_{3}\), Chinese ke liye \({}^{8}C_{2}\), phir dono ko multiply (fundamental principle of counting, yani ginti ka bunyadi usool).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 6 desi dishes (3 chunni hain) aur 8 Chinese dishes (2 chunni hain).
Humein find karna hai: poora selection kitne tareeqon se ho sakta hai.
Tareeqa: Dishes chunte waqt order se farq nahi parta (biryani pehle chuni ya qorma, menu wahi hai), is liye har hissa combination hai. Lafz "and" ka matlab hai dono kaam saath hone hain, is liye multiply karenge, jama nahi.

Desi dishes chunein
\[{}^{6}C_{3} = \dfrac{6 \cdot 5 \cdot 4}{3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1}\]
\[= \dfrac{120}{6} = 20\]
Kyun: Shortcut: 6 se neeche teen numbers multiply kiye aur \(3!\) se divide kiya.

Chinese dishes chunein
\[{}^{8}C_{2} = \dfrac{8 \cdot 7}{2 \cdot 1} = 28\]
Kyun: 8 se neeche do numbers, divide by \(2!\).

Multiply karein
\[{}^{6}C_{3} \times {}^{8}C_{2} = 20 \times 28\]
\[= 560\]
Kyun: Har ek desi selection (20 mein se koi bhi) har ek Chinese selection (28 mein se koi bhi) ke saath ja sakta hai. Jaise 2 shirts aur 3 pants se \(2 \times 3 = 6\) jore bante hain, waise hi yahan \(20 \times 28\).
Dhyan dein: \(20 + 28 = 48\) likhna ghalat hai; jama tab karte hain jab "ya" (or) ho, yani sirf ek kaam karna ho.

Tasdeeq
\[20 \times 28 = 20 \times 30 - 20 \times 2\]
\[= 600 - 40 = 560 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Doosre tareeqe se multiply karne par bhi wahi jawab aaya.
